name: 75229 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75229 (Dallas) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75229 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75229 (Dallas) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
